title: Choice-coverage gate skips subclass-granted features: model Bonus Cantrip, Circle Spells land, Lore Bonus Proficiencies, Dragon Ancestor
description:
ROOT CAUSE (Claude Captain review of eshyra-ug4i.2.1, 2026-10-08): srdPlayabilityAudit.checkChoiceCoverage iterates only grantedClassFeatureLevels (features granted by class progression rows), so subclass-granted features are never audited for prose-only build choices. The cantrip signal /\bcantrips?\b[^.]*\bof your choice\b/ matches feature:circle-of-the-land:bonus-cantrip ('you learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice') but the record is never checked.

Unmodeled subclass build choices found by a prose scan of subclass features (records.json @ 03a7c4d9):
- feature:circle-of-the-land:bonus-cantrip (L2): one druid cantrip. Level-up now emits an UNSUPPORTED descriptor (UNMODELED_SPELL_GRANT_FEATURES in levelUpSpells.ts), so a Land druid cannot pass level 2 — fail-closed per eshyra-lupf.9, but a visible block.
- feature:circle-of-the-land:circle-spells (L3): choose the land (arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp); determines always-prepared circle spells. Silently skipped today.
- feature:college-of-lore:bonus-proficiencies (L3): three skills of your choice. Silently skipped today.
- feature:draconic-bloodline:dragon-ancestor (L1): choose a dragon type (creation-time; eshyra-nnj6 territory). Silently skipped today.
Modeled already: champion additional fighting style, Lore additional magical secrets, hunter options.

FIX (docs/importer-fix-protocol.md applies): (1) extend the choice-coverage gate to subclass-granted features (audit first; expect exactly these findings); (2) add curated choices in packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/deriveFeatureChoices.ts (bonus cantrip as category cantrip with a druid-list level-0 spellFilter, like additional-magical-secrets; land as an option list; Lore skills as a skill choice; dragon ancestor as an option list) and regenerate; (3) engine: drop the UNMODELED_SPELL_GRANT_FEATURES entry (levelUpSpells handles the cantrip via its feature spell-choice path), make level-up detect the land/skills choices (fail-closed until applied), and decide where land/ancestor persist (featureChoices). Also check whether the level-up engine's subclass-feature detection silently drops any other unmodeled choice and turn that into a generalized invariant like the spell one.
notes:
2026-10-08 (Claude Captain reconciliation, audit): proof boundary is the COMPLETE applicable grant graph, not the four named examples. Enumerate every class- and subclass-granted feature reachable by the real consumers (character creation level-1 grants incl. level-1 subclasses; level-up class rows, subclass-feature slots and subclass features gained at the target level) and audit each for prose-only build choices; the four known findings are expected members, not the closed set. Acceptance: the generalized choice-coverage gate iterates that whole graph; every unmodeled player choice is either modeled (curated choice + engine detection/persistence) or an explicit fail-closed descriptor — never silently skipped — in BOTH creation and level-up. Coordinate creation-time members (e.g. dragon ancestor) with eshyra-nnj6 and always-prepared circle spells consumption with eshyra-odpc.
